name: The Stagnant Oasis
summary: Tonga Runetotem sends you southeast from the Crossroads to search the Stagnant Oasis. He wants to know if the hidden fissure beneath the Forgotten Pools has a match in its murky waters.

sections.title: A Search for Hidden Waters
sections.body: Tonga Runetotem sends you to the Stagnant Oasis after a strange fissure is found beneath the Forgotten Pools. He suspects the sudden patches of lush growth across the Barrens have a cause beneath the earth. You search the oasis's murky shallows for another opening, among predators that haunt the water.

sections.title: The Spark of Vitality
sections.body: Tonga Runetotem gives you dried seeds that cannot sprout on their own. When you place them in the bubbling fissure, they surge into growth. The spring beneath the oasis can give life to dead matter, revealing an extraordinary power at work below the Barrens.

faq.q: Who starts the quest The Stagnant Oasis?
faq.answer: Tonga Runetotem, a tauren druid at the Crossroads, sends you to investigate after the search of the Forgotten Pools.

faq.q: What do the dried seeds do?
faq.answer: Tonga gives you dead, infertile seeds to test. Place them in a fissure beneath the Stagnant Oasis and watch for any change in the water.

faq.q: Where is the Stagnant Oasis located?
faq.answer: The Stagnant Oasis lies southeast of the Crossroads in the Barrens. Rocky bluffs surround its waters, where snapjaw turtles, kolkar centaur, and other water-dwelling beasts live.

faq.q: What is the significance of the underwater fissures?
faq.answer: The fissures are mysterious cracks beneath the oasis waters. Tonga suspects they may give life to the oases and asks you to test that idea.

faq.q: What quest comes next in the chain?
faq.answer: When you return to Tonga Runetotem with your findings, he sends you on to investigate the mutations and aggressive behavior of wildlife around the pools.

faq.q: Why is the Cenarion Circle interested in these pools?
faq.answer: Cenarion druids have long sought ways to heal the Barrens' dry savanna. Springs that create life would bring hope, but the strange, sudden changes also raise concern that an unnatural force is disturbing the land.

angles.text: As a druid of the Cenarion Circle, you test the oasis with lifeless seeds to learn whether hidden forces are restoring life to the Barrens.
As a tauren, you honor the Earth Mother by seeking to understand sudden changes in the natural balance of your ancestral hunting grounds.
As a member of the Horde, you know that freshwater oases near the Crossroads help protect trade caravans and military outposts across the harsh Barrens.
